title: SABLE · editorial commerce

sources.title: Wavespace fashion commerce presentation
sources.role: Observed editorial photo hierarchy and modular commerce; no source pixels attached.

review: Three aligned screens, readable inventory and prices, consistent bag design and deliberate photo hierarchy. Repair correctly selects All and activates Shop on the collection screen; Discover stays active on the home screen.
limitations: Raster interface concept. No interaction or contrast/accessibility audit. Fine pixels may be redrawn in the repair.
technique: Define screen roles and exact copy, then inspect selected states as well as visual polish.

title: VELLUM · No. 04

sources.title: Byredo Absolu campaign
sources.role: Observed reflected light and contrast among glass, liquid and textured caps; original fictional product.

review: Exact three-line label, one coherent bottle, readable paper texture, wood grain, brushed collar and thick glass. Reflection and exposure are convincing.
limitations: Cap is taller and surface more veined than the initial direction. This is a product concept, not a measured reproduction.
technique: Specify the behavior of each material under light, and give the product a clear silhouette.

title: MORA · a morning routine

sources.title: Rhode glazing milk photography
sources.role: Observed close skin texture and intimate camera language; original synthetic person and product.

review: Natural-looking skin, flyaways, relaxed expression, plausible hand contact and clear product lettering. Keeps a phone-camera feel.
limitations: A plant and a soap dispenser were added in the background. Synthetic demonstration, not a real customer testimonial.
technique: Use everyday framing and material texture; preserve imperfections that make UGC credible.

title: MORA · from everyday to studio
review: The generated UGC subject remains recognizable after changing clothing, background and lighting. Natural skin detail, clear eyes, navy tailoring and a quiet blue-gray background give the portrait a coherent professional finish.
limitations: This is the same fictional character by visual judgment, not a measured identity-preservation result. Fine facial and hair details can change during generation.
technique: Attach the source portrait. Separate the identity to preserve from the wardrobe, setting and lighting to change.

title: Coast House · a living room

sources.title: Norm Architects — 262 Fifth Avenue
sources.role: Observed the relationship among timber, stone, soft upholstery and window light. The coastal room is an original fictional design.

review: The joinery, fireplace, window seat and glazing create a legible room. Wool, oak, limestone and upholstery have distinct texture; the coast and the room share a coherent light direction.
limitations: The sofa faces the central seating group more than the fireplace specified in the brief. Small plants, a vase and a throw were added. This is a spatial concept, not a construction design.
technique: Describe the room as connected planes, openings and furniture relationships before specifying materials.

title: Coast House · drawn study

sources.title: Norm Architects — 262 Fifth Avenue
sources.role: Observed the relationship among timber, stone, soft upholstery and window light. The coastal room is an original fictional design.

review: The viewpoint, fireplace, artwork, sofa, chair, table and window seat carry through from the generated interior. Fine contours, visible construction lines and material hatching produce a coherent architectural presentation.
limitations: The result is more densely shaded and detailed than the requested selective wash. It demonstrates image-to-sketch restyling; it is not a test of ChatGPT’s manual sketch-input interface.
technique: Lock viewpoint, object count and major positions; change the representation rather than rewriting the scene.

title: Coast House · inside the pavilion

sources.title: Norm Architects — 262 Fifth Avenue
sources.role: Observed the relationship among timber, stone, soft upholstery and window light. The coastal room is an original fictional design.

review: The cutaway makes the room legible while retaining its main furniture and materials. All five labels are readable; their leaders connect to the skylight, oak storage, living area, glazing and foundation.
limitations: The photograph cannot reveal hidden construction. Roof, wall thicknesses and foundations were invented for this conceptual section; the image does not establish structural feasibility.
technique: Use the reference for visible design. Explicitly label newly invented hidden geometry and define where each annotation must land.
